tables.articles:
CREATE TABLE articles (
                url TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT DEFAULT 'General',
                folder TEXT DEFAULT 'General',
                body_text TEXT NOT NULL,
                images_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
                last_modified TEXT,
                etag TEXT,
                status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',
                crawled_at TEXT
            , content_hash TEXT)
tables.chunks:
CREATE TABLE chunks (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                article_url TEXT NOT NULL,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT DEFAULT 'General',
                folder TEXT DEFAULT 'General',
                chunk_index INTEGER,
                text TEXT NOT NULL,
                visual_context TEXT DEFAULT '',
                embedding_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]', section_heading TEXT DEFAULT 'Overview', source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'OFFICIAL_DOC', provenance_notes TEXT, images_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
                FOREIGN KEY (article_url) REFERENCES articles(url) ON DELETE CASCADE
            )
tables.crawler_checkpoint:
CREATE TABLE crawler_checkpoint (
                url TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                last_checked TEXT,
                status_code INTEGER,
                etag TEXT,
                last_modified TEXT,
                error TEXT
            , content_hash TEXT)
tables.expert_tasks:
CREATE TABLE expert_tasks (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                question TEXT NOT NULL,
                context TEXT DEFAULT '',
                requester_email TEXT,
                status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
                expert_answer TEXT,
                created_at TEXT,
                resolved_at TEXT
            , expert_id TEXT, version TEXT DEFAULT '1.0', provenance_notes TEXT)
tables.sync_state:
CREATE TABLE sync_state (
                key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                value_json TEXT,
                updated_at TEXT
            )
tables.sitemaps:
CREATE TABLE sitemaps (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                user_id TEXT DEFAULT 'default_user',
                root_url TEXT NOT NULL,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                refresh_interval_days INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                status TEXT DEFAULT 'registered',
                last_preview_json TEXT,
                last_confirmed_at TEXT,
                created_at TEXT,
                updated_at TEXT
            )
tables.sitemap_relationships:
CREATE TABLE sitemap_relationships (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                root_sitemap_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                sitemap_url TEXT NOT NULL,
                parent_sitemap_url TEXT,
                depth INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                is_index INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                error TEXT,
                created_at TEXT
            )
tables.sitemap_refresh_runs:
CREATE TABLE sitemap_refresh_runs (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                sitemap_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                user_id TEXT DEFAULT 'default_user',
                started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                first_successful_fetch_at TEXT,
                last_successful_fetch_at TEXT,
                completed_at TEXT,
                total_discovered_urls INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                total_successfully_fetched_urls INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                added_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                updated_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                unchanged_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                failed_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                pending_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                quarantined_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                status TEXT DEFAULT 'running',
                progress_percent REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
                estimate_json TEXT
            )
tables.refresh_run_urls:
CREATE TABLE refresh_run_urls (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                url TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                http_status INTEGER,
                lastmod TEXT,
                fetched_at TEXT,
                error_message TEXT
            )
tables.url_health_status:
CREATE TABLE url_health_status (
                url TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                sitemap_id TEXT,
                consecutive_failure_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                configured_threshold INTEGER DEFAULT 3,
                expected_action TEXT DEFAULT 'Quarantine on 3 consecutive failures',
                last_checked_at TEXT,
                last_http_status INTEGER,
                is_in_sitemap INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                failure_reason TEXT
            , user_id TEXT)
tables.url_health_observations:
CREATE TABLE url_health_observations (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                url TEXT NOT NULL,
                sitemap_id TEXT,
                run_id TEXT,
                http_status INTEGER,
                redirect_url TEXT,
                is_in_sitemap INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                observed_at TEXT,
                error_reason TEXT
            )
tables.quarantine_records:
CREATE TABLE quarantine_records (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                url TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                sitemap_id TEXT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                content TEXT NOT NULL,
                chunks_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
                embeddings_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
                last_known_http_status INTEGER,
                quarantine_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
                replacement_url TEXT,
                detected_at TEXT,
                quarantined_at TEXT,
                restored_at TEXT,
                sitemap_presence_history_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]'
            , user_id TEXT)
tables.user_settings:
CREATE TABLE user_settings (
                user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                sitemap_refresh_interval_days INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                url_quarantine_threshold_x INTEGER DEFAULT 3,
                url_quarantine_action TEXT DEFAULT 'QUARANTINE_ON_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES',
                email_approval_threshold_x INTEGER DEFAULT 3,
                auto_send_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                emergency_disable INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                updated_at TEXT
            , retention_preset_days INTEGER DEFAULT 30, model_classification TEXT, model_drafting TEXT, model_kb_answer TEXT)
tables.users:
CREATE TABLE users (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                display_name TEXT,
                role TEXT DEFAULT 'user',
                created_at TEXT
            , failed_login_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0, locked_until TEXT, last_login_at TEXT)
tables.user_sessions:
CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
                session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT
            , csrf_token TEXT, last_activity_at TEXT)
tables.article_history:
CREATE TABLE article_history (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            url TEXT NOT NULL,
            version INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            change_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            previous_hash TEXT,
            new_hash TEXT,
            summary_diff TEXT,
            recorded_at TEXT
        )
tables.url_redirects:
CREATE TABLE url_redirects (
            source_url TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            target_url TEXT NOT NULL,
            http_status INTEGER DEFAULT 301,
            detected_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
